text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyoooone! Did our feelings reach you!?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: I got it~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I could hear your voices too. Your cheers 
reached me.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Really—?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. If it weren't, there 
would have been no point in us holding 
this Live.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget today. I will never 
forget the voices of support I received 
from all of you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
We will continue running forward, side by 
side with all of you...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous cheers and applause echo 
throughout the entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with the voices of their fans, 
the Umamusume continued singing song after 
song.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: —A song infused with all their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
............Such incredible cheering. To 
think I can hear it all the way out here.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Trainer, for 
supporting someone like me until the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd let me build such a 
wonderful stage... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Buzzzz, buzzzz)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm so sorry! Interrupting your 
conversation like this..."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Saying "thank you."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live, where spectators and 
Umamusume came together in unified 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yet even such a dreamlike night must come 
to an end. And then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days passed.

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, everyone. That's all for 
today's lesson!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Falcon-san. If you have time, do you 
want to review that choreography together 
from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That choreography just now was...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Of course this choreography is for the 
back dancers.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...No way. If I'm supposed to treat this 
like the real stage, smiling is even more 
out of the question. I mean, this is 
clearly the back dancer choreography.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
You know, I don't want to get used to this 
dance. If I can just smile and dance it 
casually, I feel like I'll never reach 
center stage for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ever since performing in the Grand Live 
the other day, I haven't been able to 
forget the smiles on the fans' faces.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to dance with a smile 
no matter what position I'm in. Because 
that way..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Because I realized that next time, I want 
to win for this person's sake, too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, I'm gonna fire myself up! Falco 
doesn't go easy when it comes to smiles!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Hello! How are plans going for next 
year's Grand Live?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we've coordinated with the URA and 
everything is proceeding smoothly! ...And 
on that note, there's something I'd like 
to consult everyone about.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What can I do for you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We'd like to use this photo for the next 
main announcement poster.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A photo?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Isn't this from the Grand 
Live...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It's a wonderful photo, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Even the person who took this photo 
said so with a smile."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to shine with all my might too, 
so that I wouldn't lose to them."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"And it made me want to cheer with 
everything I've got," they said.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Pass those feelings on to the girls making 
their debuts next. And to the people who 
will newly become fans.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: —May I carry on this baton?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing Light Hello's words, not a 
single girl shook her head in 
disagreement."
